But rather, ‘a still voice of perfect mildness, as if it had been a whisper’, and it can ‘pierce even to the very soul’, and ’cause the heart to burn’. Remember, Elijah found the voice of the Lord was not in the wind, nor in the earthquake, nor in the fire, but was a ‘still small voice’. The Spirit does not get our attention by shouting or shaking us with a heavy hand. Rather it whispers. It caresses so gently that if we are preoccupied we may not feel it at all. (No wonder that the Word of Wisdom was revealed to us, for how could the drunkard or the addict feel such a voice?) Occasionally, it will press just firmly enough for us to pay heed. But most of the time, if we do not heed the gentle feeling, the Spirit will withdraw and wait until we come seeking and listening and say in our manner and expression, like Samuel of ancient times, ‘Speak Lord, for they servant heareth’.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: The simpler and more straightforward a goal is. The more power it will have.

quotes.author: Elaine S. Dalton
quotes.quote: Work hard to achieve your dreams. Don't let discouragement or mistakes delay you.

quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.quote: God knows and loves each of us and He eagerly desires to make Himself known to us.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: There is no threshold of perfection you must attain in order to qualify for God's grace.

quotes.author: Ricardo P. Gimenez
quotes.quote: This single refuge provided by our Heavenly Father is our Lord Jesus Christ and His Atonement.

quotes.author: Ricardo P. Gimenez
quotes.quote: I know that we are all child of God, that He loves us, and that we are not alone. I invite you to come and see that He can lighten your burdens and be the refuge you are seeking.

quotes.author: Dale G. Renlund
quotes.quote: Reflecting on God's goodness and mercy help us become more spiritually receptive.

quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.quote: From time to time, God powerfully and very personally assures each of that He knows us and loves us, and that he is blessing us specifically and openly.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: The fires and tumults of mortal life may threaten and frighten, but those who incline their hearts to God will be encircled by His peace. Their joy will not be diminished. They will not be abandoned or forgotten.

quotes.author: Neal A. Maxwell
quotes.quote: Laman and Lemuel became rebels instead of leaders, resentful instead of righteous - all because of their failure to understand either the character or the purposes of God.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Your Heavenly Father loves you - each of you. That love never changes. It is not influenced by your appearance, by your possessions, or by the amount of money you have in your bank account. It is not changed by your talents and abilities. It is simply there. It is there for you when you are sad or happy, discourage or hopeful. God's love is there for you whether or not you feel you deserve love. It is simply always there.

quotes.author: Dale G. Renlund
quotes.quote: God cares a lot more about who we are and about who we are becoming, than about who we once were.

quotes.author: Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.quote: In the midst of life's greatest storms, do not forget your divine heritage as a son or daughter of God.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Though we are incomplete, God loves us completely. Though we are imperfect, He loves us perfectly. Though we may feel lost and without compass, God’s love encompasses us completely. … He loves every one of us, even those who are flawed, rejected, awkward, sorrowful, or broken

quotes.author: Joseph B. Wirthlin
quotes.quote: David saw himself as a shepherd, but the Lord saw him as a king of Israel. Joseph of Egypt served as a slave, but the Lord saw him as a seer. Mormon wore the armor of a soldier, but the Lord saw him as a prophet.

quotes.author: Boyd K. Packer
quotes.quote: You are a child of God. He is the father of your spirit. Spiritually you are of noble birth, the offspring of the King of Heaven. Fix that truth in your mind and hold to it. However many generations in your mortal ancestry, no matter what race or people you represent, the pedigree of your spirit can be written on a single line. You are a child of God!

quotes.author: Joseph B. Wirthlin
quotes.quote: Your Heavenly Father—who knows when even a sparrow falls—knows of your heartache and suffering.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: God never leaves us alone, never leaves us unaided in the challenges that we face.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Heavenly Father loves you—each of you. That love never changes.

quotes.author: Julie C. Donaldson
quotes.quote: You even on your worst days, are divine royalty.

quotes.author: Lauren Daigle
quotes.quote: There's never been a moment you were forgotten by God.

quotes.author: Bonnie H. Cordon
quotes.quote: By virtue of the restoration of His gospel, we can be filled with the light of the Savior.

quotes.author: Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.quote: The doctrine of Jesus Christ unites all of us - around the world - as sons and daughters of God, as brothers and sisters in the gospel.

quotes.author: Benjamin M. Z. Tai
quotes.quote: By consistently applying the doctrine of Christ in our lives, we will overcome inertia that impedes change and fear that foils action.

quotes.author: Douglas D. Holmes
quotes.quote: The Gospel of Jesus Christ is the greatest cause in the world.

quotes.author: L. Whitney Clayton
quotes.quote: This work of the Lord is indeed great and marvelous ... It progresses one heart and one family at a time, silently and unobtrusively, its sacred message blessing people everywhere.

quotes.author: Joseph B. Wirthlin
quotes.quote: The gospel of Jesus Christ is not a religion of mourning and gloom. The faith of our fathers is one of hope and joy. It is not a gospel of chains but a gospel of wings.

quotes.author: David O. McKay
quotes.quote: The purpose of the gospel is to make bad men good and good men better.

quotes.author: Jean A. Stevens
quotes.quote: The gospel ‘is not weight; it is wings.’ It carries us.

quotes.author: Richard J. Maynes
quotes.quote: Because we face challenges every day, it is important that we work on our spiritual stamina every day. When we develop spiritual stamina, the false traditions of the world, as well as our personal daily challenges, will have little negative impact on our ability to endure in righteousness.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: As we ponder the teachings of the gospel and apply them in daily living, we become better prepared to receive additional light and truth.

quotes.author: Quentin L. Cook
quotes.quote: If we truly want to have the spirit of the Lord and experience joy and happiness, we should rejoice in our blessings and be grateful.

quotes.author: Robert D. Hales
quotes.quote: In some quiet way, the expression and feelings of gratitude have a wonderful cleansing or healing nature. Gratitude brings warmth to the giver and the receiver alike.

quotes.author: Marion G. Romney
quotes.quote: To the Lord Jesus, who bought us with a great price, we owe an undying debt of gratitude. All people who understand what Jesus did for us ought to love Him and demonstrate that love by rendering to Him, in a realistic manner, thanks and gratitude.

quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.quote: Let me recommend that periodically you and I offer a prayer in which we only give thanks and express gratitude. Ask for nothing; simply let our souls rejoice and strive to communicate appreciation with all the energy of our hearts.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: We sometimes think that being grateful is what we do after our problems are solved, but how terrible short sighted that is. How much of life do we miss by waiting to see the rainbow before thanking God that there is rain?

quotes.author: Joseph Fielding Smith
quotes.quote: The spirit of gratitude is always pleasant and satisfying because it carries with it a sense of helpfulness to others; it beget love and friendship, and engenders divine influence. Gratitude is said to be memory of the heart.

quotes.author: James E. Faust
quotes.quote: A grateful heart is a beginning of greatness.

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.quote: The habit of saying thank you is the mark of a cultivated mind.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: Understand that healing can take considerable time. Recovery generally comes in steps. It is accelerated when gratitude is expressed to the Lord for every degree of improvement noted.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: We can lift ourselves, and others as well, when we refuse to remain in the realm of negative thought and cultivate within our hearts an attitude of gratitude. If ingratitude be numbered among the serious sins, then gratitude takes its place among the noblest of virtues.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Endings are not our destiny.

quotes.author: Ricardo P. Gimenez
quotes.quote: In my experience, significant spiritual guidance most often comes when we are trying to bless others in fulfilling our responsibilities.

quotes.author: Laudy R. Kaouk
quotes.quote: Don't hesitate to ask for a blessing when you need extra guidance. It is in our difficult moments that we need the spirit to help us the most.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: I testify that the future is going to be as miracle-filled and bountifully blessed as the past has been.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: Because the restoration reaffirmed the foundational truth the God does work in this world, we can hope, we should hope even when facing the most insurmountable odds.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: We all need to believe that what we desire in righteousness can someday, some way, somehow yet be ours.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: May we press forward with love in our hearts, walking in the brightness of hope that lights the path of holy anticipation that we've been on now for 200 years.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: My dear friends, our Heavenly Father and His Son Jesus Christ know us, love us, and are watching over us. Of that we can be certain...these unique challenges will pass in due time. I remain optimistic for the future.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: These unique challenges will pass in due time. I remain optimistic for the future. I know the great and marvelous blessings that God has in store for those who love Him and serve Him. I see evidence of His hand in this holy work in so many ways.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Though the storm clouds may gather, though the rains may pour down upon us, our knowledge of the gospel and our love of our Heavenly Father and of our Savior will comfort and sustain us and bring joy to our hearts...fear not. BE OF GOOD CHEER. The future is as bright as your faith.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Because God has been faithful and kept his promises in the past, we can hope with confidence that God will keep His promises to us in the present and in the future.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: Hope on. Journey on.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: When you feel that there is only a thin thread of hope, it is really not a thread but a massive connecting link.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: Think the best and hope the best and have faith in the future.

quotes.author: Rosemary M. Wixom
quotes.quote: Laugh about the past—and dream about the future.

quotes.author: Mary G. Cook
quotes.quote: Be of good cheer, for we know the outcome, we know the truth; we know the Savior.

quotes.author: Adrian Ochoa
quotes.quote: Don't forget to look up.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: We pray that you will begin anew truly to hear, hearken to and heed the words of the Savior. I promise that decreased fear and increased faith will follow.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: We will be strengthened as we become even more valiant disciple of the Lord, standing up and speaking up for Him wherever we are.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: Our Father knows that when we are surrounded by uncertainty and fear, what will help us the very most is to hear His son.

quotes.author: Gerrit W. Gong
quotes.quote: In celebrating the ongoing restoration of the gospel of Jesus Christ, we also prepare for Easter. In both, we rejoice in the return of Jesus Christ.

quotes.author: John A. McCune
quotes.quote: Even in our deepest trials, we can feel the warm embrace of the Savior's love as we trust and accept His will. We can experience the joy reserved for His faithful disciples, for Christ is joy.

quotes.author: John A. McCune
quotes.quote: As we remained focused on Christ, we will feel peace and see God's miracles, whatever they may be, in His time and in His way.

quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.quote: We hear Him in our prayers, in our homes, in the scriptures, in our hymns, as we worthily partake of the sacrament, as we declare our faith, as we serve others and as we attend the temple with fellow believers.

quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.quote: The spiritually defining memories from our book of life are like luminous stones that help brighten the road ahead, assuring us that God knows us, loves us and has send His son Jesus Christ to help us return home.

quotes.author: James R. Rasband
quotes.quote: The magnificent, peace-giving promise of the Book of Mormon and the restored gospel is that the Savior will mend all that we have broken.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: I know that the Savior is pleased when we present Him an offering from our hearts in righteousness.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: Our ultimate quest in life is to prepare to meet our maker. We do this by striving daily to become more like our Savior, Jesus Christ. And we do that as we repent daily and receive His cleansing, healing and strengthening power.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: God the Father pointed at His son Jesus Christ and said, 'This is my beloved Son, hear Him'. That admission given to each of us, to 'Hear Him'.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: The Savior loves you and knows you personally. He knows of your challenges. He knows your circumstances. He knows the profoundest concerns of your souls. He also knows your faith and your desire to serve Him.

quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.quote: Jesus Christ is the only source of enduring peace.

quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.quote: Christ knows our struggles, our heartaches, our sufferings because he has felt them all.

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.quote: Never assume that you can make it alone. You need the help of the Lord.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: The Lord Jesus Christ atoned for us. As we repent, He has the power to forgive, redeem us from sin, change our hearts, strengthen us, and keep us on the path to our Heavenly Father.

quotes.author: Bonnie H. Cordon
quotes.quote: As you draw closer to Him, even taking the smallest baby steps forward, you will discover the lasting peace that settles into your soul as a faithful disciple of our Savior, Jesus Christ.

quotes.author: CS Lewis
quotes.quote: Look for Christ and you will find Him. And with Him, everything else.

quotes.author: Joy D. Jones
quotes.quote: Jesus Christ is the perfect gift - the gift that never stops giving.

quotes.author: CS Lewis
quotes.quote: Once in our world, a stable had something in it that was bigger than our whole world.

quotes.author: Linda K. Burton
quotes.quote: I feel certain that, as premortals spirits learning of the plan of salvation, we not only beheld and adored but also shouted for joy when he voluntarily and humbly offered himself as the Savior of the world. In five of the most profound words ever uttered, He meekld said, "Here am I, send me."

quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.quote: Jesus Christ is the light that dispels fear, provides assurance and direction, and engenders enduring peace and joy.

quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.quote: Let our focus remain on the Savior.

quotes.author: Dale G. Renlund
quotes.quote: As we become more like Christ, we begin to treat others as He would.

quotes.author: Steven W. Owen
quotes.quote: Christ is the greatest leader because He is the greatest follower - He follows His father perfectly, in all things.

quotes.author: D. Todd Christofferson
quotes.quote: His desire is for us to progress.

quotes.author: Robert C. Gay
quotes.quote: The Savior look upon the samaritan, the adulterer, the tax collector, the leper, the mentally ill and the sinner with the same eyes. All were children of His father. All were redeemable.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: We must keep Christ as the center of our lives at all times and in all places.

quotes.author: Neal L. Maxwell
quotes.quote: Each of us is an innkeeper who decides if there is room for Jesus.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Do we have a guide to help us choose the right and avoid dangerous detours? I have tried to pattern my life after the Master. Whenever I have a difficult decision to make, I have looked at that picture and asked myself, “What would He do?” Then I try to do it. We can never go wrong when we choose to follow the Savior.

quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.quote: Many carry heavy burdens. Some have lost a loved one to death or care for one who is disabled. Some have been wounded by divorce. Others yearn for an eternal marriage. Some are caught in the grip of addictive substances or practices like alcohol, tobacco, drugs, or pornography. Others have crippling physical or mental impairments. Some are challenged by same-gender attraction. Some have terrible feelings of depression or inadequacy. In one way or another, many are heavy laden. To each of us our Savior gives this loving invitation: “Come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. “Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.” ”For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light” (Matthew 11:28–30).

quotes.author: Brad Wilcox
quotes.quote: Christ asks us to show faith in Him, repent, make and keep covenants, receive the Holy Ghost, and endure to the end. By complying, we are not paying the demands of justice—not even the smallest part. Instead, we are showing appreciation for what Jesus Christ did by using it to live a life like His.

quotes.author: Tad R. Callister
quotes.quote: We become like those things we habitually love and admire. And thus, as we study Christ's life and live his teachings, we become more like him.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: If we choose Christ, we will have made the right choice.

quotes.author: Paul V. Johnson
quotes.quote: The Lord does not leave us to find our way on our own.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Whether it is the best of times or the worst of times, He is with us. He has promised that this will never change.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: Believe that there is a ‘balm in Gilead’ and that the Lord has promised, ‘I will not … forsake thee.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: With Christ, darkness cannot succeed. Darkness will not gain victory over the light of Christ.

quotes.author: Linda S. Reeves
quotes.quote: Our Savior has the power to cleanse and heal you.

quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.quote: He knows of our anguish, and He is there for us.

quotes.author: Dale G. Renlund
quotes.quote: Like the true shepherd He is, He seeks us and finds us to offer relief and hope.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: It is mentally rigorous to strive to look unto Him in every thought. But when we do, our doubts and fears flee.

quotes.author: Carole M. Stephens
quotes.quote: Hope and healing are not found in the dark abyss of secrecy but in the light and love of our Savior, Jesus Christ.

quotes.author: Julie B. Beck
quotes.quote: The Lord will take care of you.

quotes.author: K. Brett Nattress
quotes.quote: The Savior provided the perfect example of how to live in an imperfect and unfair world.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: The Savior gave His life for your happiness He understands your every need.

quotes.author: D. Todd Christofferson
quotes.quote: The Savior makes all things right.

quotes.author: Joseph Smith Jr
quotes.quote: You don't know me; you never knew my heart. No man knows my history. I cannot tell it: I shall never undertake it. I don't blame anyone for not believing my history. If I had not experienced what I have, I would not have believed it myself. I never did harm any man since I was born in the world. My voice is always for peace.

quotes.author: Joseph B. Wirthlin
quotes.quote: Kindness is the essence of greatness.

quotes.author: Joseph Smith Jr
quotes.quote: A man who is full of the love of God is not content with blessing his family only, but thinks about all of the people in the world, anxious to bless the whole human race.

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.quote: He who lives only unto himself withers and dies, while he who forgets himself in the service of others grows and blossoms in this life and in eternity.

quotes.author: Neal A. Maxwell
quotes.quote: The Lord does not ask for our inability or ability, only our availability shows unto him our dependability, and HE will give you capability.

quotes.author: Bruce R. McConkie
quotes.quote: All of those called to the ministry...are given the gifts needed to perform the work whereunto they are called. These gifts are always the ones needed for the particular work at hand.

quotes.author: John Taylor
quotes.quote: If you do not magnify your callings, God will hold you responsible for those whom you might have saved had you done your duty.

quotes.author: Harold B. Lee
quotes.quote: There is an urgent need for leaders of the Church at all levels to spiritualize their leadership more so that our overarching purposes are not lost in the mechanics of meetings, organizations.

quotes.author: Boyd K. Packer
quotes.quote: Life is meant to be a test to see if we will keep the commandments of God.

quotes.author: David O. McKay
quotes.quote: Man’s chief concern in life should not be the acquiring of gold, or of fame, or of material possessions. It should not be the development of physical prowess, nor of intellectual strength, but his aim, the highest in life, should be the development of a Christ-like character.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: We came to earth to be tried, tested, and to choose.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: The great test of life is to see whether we will hearken to and obey God's commands in the midst of the storms of life. It is not to endure storms, but to choose the right while they rage.

quotes.author: Joseph Smith Jr
quotes.quote: ...as my life consisted of activity and unyielding exertions, I made this my rule: When the Lord commands, do it!

quotes.author: Brigham Young
quotes.quote: Love the givers more than the gift.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Now is the best time to start becoming the person we eventually want to be.

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.quote: It will all work out.

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.quote: You are someone special.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: If you are one the right path, it will always be uphill.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: Looking for weakness in others is easy, but missing out on their humanity is a mistake.

quotes.author: Boyd K. Packer
quotes.quote: You may think that Lehi's dream or vision has no special meaning for you, but it does. You are in it; all of us are in it.... Lehi's dream or vision of the iron has in it everything a Latter-Day Saint needs to understand the test of life.

quotes.author: Michelle D. Craig
quotes.quote: I have learned that when I wallow in thoughts of everything I am not, I do not progress and I find it much more difficult to feel and follow the spirit.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: Think the best of each other, especially of those you say you love. Assume the good and doubt the bad.

quotes.author: Ezra Taft Benson
quotes.quote: When we put God first, all others things fall into their proper place or drop out of our lives.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Our task is to become our best selves. One of God's greatest gifts to us is the joy of trying again, for no failure ever need be final.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: Individual worthiness requires a total conversion of mind and heart to be more like the Lord, to be an honest citizen, to be a better example and to be a holier person.

quotes.author: L. Whitney Clayton
quotes.quote: As we become more like the Lord, we will feel at home in His house, and He will feel at home in ours.

quotes.author: Bonnie H. Cordon
quotes.quote: I have come to love the phrase 'that they may see'. It is an earnest invitation from the Lord to be more intentional about helping others see the path and thereby come unto Christ.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: ...strive for steady improvement.

quotes.author: Lorenzo Snow
quotes.quote: Be better today than you were yesterday, and be better tomorrow than you are today.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: Rich or poor, we are to do what we can when others are in need.

quotes.author: Gary E. Stevenson
quotes.quote: I don't think we can overstate the importance of such a firm foundation in our personal lives.

quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.quote: Through the years, I have reflected on these words: “It’s true, isn’t it? Then what else matters?” These questions have helped me put difficult issues in proper perspective. The cause in which we are laboring is true. We respect the beliefs of our friends and neighbors. We are all sons and daughters of God. We can learn much from other men and women of faith and goodness.

quotes.author: Brigham Young
quotes.quote: No matter what your circumstances are, whether you are in prosperity or in adversity, you can learn from every person, transaction, and circumstance around you.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: What are the three most important decisions? First, what will be my faith? Second, whom shall I marry? Third, what will be my life’s work?

quotes.author: Neal A. Maxwell
quotes.quote: God does not begin by asking us about our ability, but only about our availability, and if we then prove our dependability, he will increase our capability!

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: So much in life depends on our attitude. The way we choose to see things and respond to others makes all the difference. To do the best we can and then to choose to be happy about our circumstances, whatever they may be, can bring peace and contentment. … We can’t direct the wind, but we can adjust the sails. For maximum happiness, peace, and contentment, may we choose a positive attitude.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: Set goals that are well balanced—not too many nor too few, and not too high nor too low. Write down your attainable goals and work on them according to their importance. Pray for divine guidance in your goal setting.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Remember who you are and what God expects you to become.

quotes.author: Joy D. Jones
quotes.quote: Our journey does, indeed take effort, hard work, and study, but our commitment to progress brings eternal rewards.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: Our Heavenly Father did not put us on earth to fail but to succeed gloriously.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: It is impossible to fail when you do your best when you are on the Lord’s errand.

quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.quote: This is very important: as we do our best, He will not let us fail.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: The Lord is in the details of our lives.

quotes.author: Mark Ogletree
quotes.quote: Being listened to is one of the highest forms of respect and validation.

quotes.author: D. Todd Christofferson
quotes.quote: If the love of Christ dwells in us, others will know that our love for them is genuine. If the light of the Holy Spirit burns within us, it will rekindle the light of Christ within them.

quotes.author: Quentin L. Cook
quotes.quote: The Savior taught us to love even our enemies.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Remember, you are never alone. Never forget that you are loved. Never doubt that someone surely cares for you.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: Pure Christlike love flowing from righteousness can change the world.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Love should be our walk and our talk.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: True love requires action.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Love is the essence of the gospel and Jesus Christ is our exemplar

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Love is the measure of our faith, the inspiration for our obedience, and the true altitude of our discipleship.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: The supreme characteristic of love is always loyalty.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: One of the great goals of true love is to help each other in those difficult times.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Never let a problem to be solved become more important than a person to be loved.

quotes.author: Anne C. Pingree
quotes.quote: We can alter the face of the earth one family and one home at a time through charity, our small and simple acts of pure love.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: We cannot truly love God if we do not love our fellow travelers on this mortal journey.

quotes.author: F. Burton Howard
quotes.quote: If you want something to last forever, you treat it differently.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: There is no more important commitment in time or in eternity than marriage.

quotes.author: Spencer W. Kimball
quotes.quote: We do have miracles today—beyond imagination!

quotes.author: Heber J. Grant
quotes.quote: Many men say: 'If I could only see an angel, if I could only hear an angel proclaim something, that would cause me to be faithful all the days of my life!' It had no effect on these men (Laman & Lemeul) that were not serving the Lord, and it would have no effect today.

quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.quote: At times we thoughtfully wonder why the miracle we have so earnestly prayed for does not happen. … Whether in this life or the next, all will be made right.

quotes.author: Gary E. Stevenson
quotes.quote: Heavenly Father can take our simple, daily efforts and turn them into something miraculous.

quotes.author: Bonnie H. Cordon
quotes.quote: Christ will bring the light if we will just point others to Him.

quotes.author: Enzo S. Petelo
quotes.quote: We are given the opportunity to minister like angels, to preach the gospel on all the continents of the earth, and to helps souls come unto Christ.

quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.quote: If fathers would magnify their priesthood in their own family, it would further the mission of the church as much as anything else they might do.

quotes.author: Ezra Taft Benson
quotes.quote: Callings in the church, as important as they are, by their very nature are only for a period of time, and then an appropriate release takes place. But a father’s calling is eternal, and its importance transcends time. It is a calling for both time and eternity.

quotes.author: James E. Faust
quotes.quote: Being a father or a mother is not only a great challenge, it is a divine calling. It is an effort requiring consecration. President David O. McKay stated that being parents is “the greatest trust that has been given to human beings.

quotes.author: Howard W. Hunter
quotes.quote: Indeed, one of the greatest things a father can do for his children is to love their mother. A man who holds the priesthood regards the family as ordained of God. Your leadership of the family is your most important and sacred responsibility. The family is the most important unit in time and in eternity and, as such, transcends every other interest in life.

quotes.author: Spencer W. Kimball
quotes.quote: Fathers and mothers, your foremost responsibility is your family. By working together you can have the kind of home the Lord expects you to have. By showing love and consideration for one another and for your children, you can build a reservoir of spiritual strength that will never run dry.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: I am a father, inadequate to be sure, but I cannot comprehend the burden it must have been for God in His heaven to witness the deep suffering and Crucifixion of His Beloved Son in such a manner. His every impulse and instinct must have been to stop it, to send angels to intervene – but He did not intervene. He endured what He saw because it was the only way that a saving, vicarious payment could be made for the sins of all His other children from Adam and Eve to the end of the world. I am eternally grateful for a perfect Father and His perfect Son, neither of whom shrank from the bitter cup nor forsook the rest of us who are imperfect, who fall short and stumble, who too often miss the mark.

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.quote: With the obligation to beget goes the responsibility to nurture, to protect, to teach, to guide in righteousness and truth. Yours is the power and the responsibility to preside in a home where there is peace and security, love and harmony.

quotes.author: Howard W. Hunter
quotes.quote: We urge you to do all in your power to allow your wife to remain in the home, caring for the children while you provide for the family the best you can.

quotes.author: Howard W. Hunter
quotes.quote: You should express regularly to your wife and children your reverence and respect for her. Indeed, one of the greatest things a father can do for his children is to love their mother.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: There is no other relationship quite like that which can and should exist between a boy and his dad. It can be one of the most nurturing, joyful relationships in life, one that can have a profound impact on who boys become and also on who dads become. Now, I understand that some of you young men do not have fathers with whom you can have these kinds of conversations. And some of you men do not have sons or have lost your sons to accident or illness. But much of what I say tonight will apply to uncles and grandfathers and priesthood leaders and other mentors who sometimes fill the gaps for these significant father-son relationships.

quotes.author: Sheri Dew
quotes.quote: You were born to lead as mothers and fathers because nowhere is righteous leadership more crucial than in the family. You were born to lead as priesthood and auxiliary leaders, as heads of communities, companies, and even nations. You were born to lead as men and women willing 'to stand as witnesses of God at all times and in all things, and in all places' because that's what a true leader does.

quotes.author: David O. McKay
quotes.quote: No nobler work in this world can be performed by any mother than to rear and love the children with whom God has blessed her. That is her duty.

quotes.author: Neal A. Maxwell
quotes.quote: Patience is not indifference. Actually, it is caring very much, but being willing, nevertheless, to submit both to the Lord and to what the scriptures call the ‘process of time.’ Patience is tied very closely to faith in our Heavenly Father. Actually, when we are unduly impatient, we are suggesting that we know what is best—better than does God. Or, at least, we are asserting that our timetable is better than his

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Patience is a process of perfection. The Savior Himself said that in your patience you possess your souls. Or, to use another translation of the Greek text, in your patience you win mastery of your souls. Patience means to abide in faith, knowing that sometimes it is in the waiting rather than in the receiving that we grow the most. This was true in the time of the Savior. It is true in our time as well, for we are commanded in these latter days to ‘continue in patience until ye are perfected'

quotes.author: Marvin J. Ashton
quotes.quote: Have more patience with yourself—more self-understanding. I would plead that we understand it is not our role to be self-condemning. I like to think when we are taught ‘Judge not, that ye be not judged,’ that it has direct reference to us and our relationship with ourselves. We should not judge ourselves. We should teach ourselves patience—patience to believe in ourselves, patience to motivate ourselves, patience to believe that God and I can do it. When necessary, lean on the truth ‘I am a child of God.’ God and I, with patience on my part, can do it. I remind you we do not have to worry about the patience of God, because he is the personification of patience, no matter where we have been, what we have done, or what we, to this moment, have allowed ourselves to think of ourselves

quotes.author: Joseph B. Wirthlin
quotes.quote: A certain amount of impatience may be useful to stimulate and motivate us to action. However, I believe that a lack of patience is a major cause of the difficulties and unhappiness in the world today. Too often, we are impatient with ourselves, with our family members and friends, and even with the Lord. We seem to demand what we want right now, regardless of whether we have earned it, whether it would be good for us, or whether it is right…Perhaps the practice of patience is more difficult, yet more necessary, now than at any previous time

quotes.author: Robert C. Oaks
quotes.quote: Recently I attended the funeral of a lifelong friend. His son told a beautiful story of parental patience. When the son was in his youth, his dad owned a motorcycle dealership. One day they received a shipment of shiny new motorcycles, and they lined them all up in the store. The boy did what every boy would like to do, and he climbed up on the closest one. He even started it up. Then, when he figured he had pushed his luck far enough, he jumped off. To his dismay, his dismount knocked the first bike down. Then, like a string of dominoes, they all went down, one after another. His dad heard the commotion and looked out from behind the partition where he was working. Slowly, smiling, he said, ‘Well, son, we had better fix one up and sell it, so we can pay for the rest of them.’

quotes.author: Robert D. Hales
quotes.quote: Too often we pray to have patience, but we want it right now! As a young man, President David O. McKay prayed for a witness of the truthfulness of the gospel. Many years later, while he was serving his mission in Scotland, that witness finally came. Later he wrote, ‘It was an assurance to me that sincere prayer is answered “sometime, somewhere'

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: In sickness, with its attendant pain, patience is required. If the only perfect man who ever lived—even Jesus of Nazareth—was called upon to endure great suffering, how can we, who are less than perfect, expect to be free of such challenges?

quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.quote: Sometimes His power heals an infirmity, but the scriptures and our experiences teach that sometimes He succors or helps by giving us the strength or patience to endure our infirmities.

quotes.author: Bonnie L. Oscarson
quotes.quote: One of the hardest challenges in this life is to have faith in the Lord’s timing.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: The lessons we learn from patience will cultivate our character, lift our lives, and heighten our happiness.

quotes.author: Sarah Jenkins
quotes.quote: Patience means humbly accepting the Lord’s timing—whatever it is.

quotes.author: Brigham Young
quotes.quote: Give me patience to wait until I can understand it for myself.

quotes.author: Laudy R. Kaouk
quotes.quote: I have learned to turn to my patriarchal blessing whenever I feel sad or lonely.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Patriarchs are humble men. They are students of the scriptures. They stand before God as the means whereby the blessings of heaven can flow from that eternal source to the recipient on whose head rests the hands of the patriarch. He may not be a man of letters, a possessor of worldly wealth, or a holder of distinguished office. He, however, must be blessed with priesthood power and personal purity. To reach to heaven for divine guidance and inspiration, a patriarch is to be a man of love, a man of compassion, a man of judgment, a man of God.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: [A patriarchal blessing] will chart our course and give us safe passage to our heavenly home.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Permissiveness, immorality, pornography, drugs, the power of peer pressure- all these and more- cause many to be tossed about on a sea of sin and crushed on the jagged reefs of lost opportunities, forfeited blessings, and shattered dreams.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Stay completely away from pornography. Do not allow yourself to view it, ever. It has been proven to be an addiction which is more than difficult to overcome.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Be Cautious. These same technologies can allow evil influences to cross the threshold of your homes. These dangerous traps are only a mouse click away. Pornography, violence, intolerance, and ungodliness destroy families, marriages, and individual lives. These dangers are distributed through many media, including magazines, books, television, movies, and music, as well as the internet.

quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.quote: Pornography impairs one’s ability to enjoy a normal emotional, romantic, and spiritual relationship with a person of the opposite sex. It erodes the moral barriers that stand against inappropriate, abnormal, or illegal behavior. As conscience is desensitized, patrons of pornography are led to act out what they have witnessed, regardless of its effects on their life and the lives of others.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: When I pray with faith, I have the Savior as my advocate with the Father and I can feel that my prayer reaches heaven. Answers come. Blessings are received. There is peace and joy even in hard times.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: Joseph came to realize that the bible did not contain all the answers to life's questions. Rather, it taught men and women how they could find answers to their questions by communicating directly with God through prayer.

quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.quote: Nephi did not pray to have his circumstances changed. Rather, he prayed for the strength to change his circumstances.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: No one has failed who keeps trying and keeps praying.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: Our own desires, rather than a feeling of “Thy will be done,” create the feeling of a pavilion blocking God. God is not unable to see us or communicate with us, but we may be unwilling to listen or submit to His will and His time… We remove the pavilion when we feel and pray, “Thy will be done” and “in Thine own time.” His time should be soon enough for us since we know that He wants only what is best.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: Healing best begins with your sincere prayer asking your Father in Heaven for help. That use of your agency allows divine intervention. When you permit it, the love of the Savior will soften your heart and break the cycle of abuse that can transform a victim into an aggressor. Adversity, even when caused willfully by others’ unrestrained appetite, can be a source of growth when viewed from the perspective of eternal principle (see D&C 122:7).

quotes.author: Bruce R. McConkie
quotes.quote: We are to solve our own problems and then to counsel with the Lord in prayer and receive a spiritual confirmation that our decisions are correct.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: To strengthen our relationship with God, we need to spend some meaningful time alone with Him.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: Heavenly Father hears your prayers, loves you, and He knows your name.

quotes.author: Boyd K. Packer
quotes.quote: Prayer is your personal key to heaven. The lock is on your side of the veil. Learn to pray. Pray often. Pray in your mind. In your heart. Pray on your knees.

quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.quote: Pray to your Heavenly Father. … He will open doors, remove roadblocks, and help you overcome obstacles.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Our Heavenly Father does answer prayers in His own time and in His own way.

quotes.author: Martin Luther
quotes.quote: All who call on God in true faith will certainly be heard.

quotes.author: John Bunyan
quotes.quote: Prayer will make a man cease from sin, or sin will entice a man to cease from prayer.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: A key to improved prayer is to ask the right questions.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: In your morning prayer each new day, ask Heavenly Father to guide you to recognize an opportunity to serve one of His precious children.

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.quote: Get on your knees and ask for the blessings of the Lord; then stand on your feet and do what you are asked to do.

quotes.author: Carol F. McConkie
quotes.quote: Prayer Is a Gift From God.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: Never feel you are too unworthy to pray

quotes.author: Spencer W. Kimball
quotes.quote: If you succeed, it isn't because of luck. Success comes from faith and work and prayer.

quotes.author: Juan A. Uceda
quotes.quote: At the very moment we say, ‘Father in Heaven,’ He hears our prayers and is sensitive to us and our needs.

quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.quote: The priesthood is a divine power and authority held in trust to be used for God's work for the benefit of all of His children.

quotes.author: Enzo S. Petelo
quotes.quote: We must not wait for those who need our aid to seek us out. It is our duty as priesthood holders to exemplify and stand as witnesses of God.

quotes.author: Laudy R. Kaouk
quotes.quote: Regardless of your circumstances, you can always have access to priesthood blessings

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Yes, there is always something imperfect in any situation. Yes, it is easy to find things to complain about. But brethren, we are bearers of the Holy Priesthood, after the Order of the Son of God! .. I feel a certain sadness for those who do not grasp and appreciate the wonder and privilege of the priesthood. They are like passengers on an airplane who spend their time grumbling about the size of the packet of peanuts while they are soaring through the air, far above the clouds.

quotes.author: D. Todd Christofferson
quotes.quote: We cannot afford young men who lack self-discipline and live only to be entertained. We cannot afford young adult men who are going nowhere in life, who are not serious about forming families and making a real contribution in this world. We cannot afford husbands and fathers who fail to provide spiritual leadership in the home. We cannot afford to have those who exercise the Holy Priesthood, after the Order of the Son of God, waste their strength in pornography or spend their lives in cyberspace. Brethren, we have work to do.

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.quote: It will be a marvelous day, my brethren—it will be a day of fulfillment of the purposes of the Lord—when our priesthood quorums become an anchor of strength to every man belonging thereto, when each such man may appropriately be able to say, ‘I am a member of a priesthood quorum of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. I stand ready to assist my brethren in all of their needs, as I am confident they stand ready to assist me in mine. … Working together, we can stand, without embarrassment and without fear, against every wind of adversity that might blow, be it economic, social, or spiritual.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: The kingdom of God is governed by the authority of the priesthood. It is not conferred for honor, but for a ministry of service. Priesthood titles are not created by man; neither are they for adornment, nor do they express mastership. They denote appointment to service in the work of the Lord.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: Your priesthood quorums provide opportunities for friendship, service, and learning. But the responsibility to develop power in the priesthood is personal. Only as an individual can you develop a firm faith in God and a passion for personal prayer.

quotes.author: Boyd K. Packer
quotes.quote: Priesthood holders carry with them the antidote to remove the terrible images of pornography and to wash away guilt. The priesthood has the power to unlock the influence of our habits, even to unchain from addiction, however tight the grip. It can heal over the scars of past mistakes.

quotes.author: D. Todd Christofferson
quotes.quote: We cannot afford husbands and fathers who fail to provide spiritual leadership in the home. We cannot afford to have those who exercise the Holy Priesthood, after the Order of the Son of God, waste their strength in pornography or spend their lives in cyberspace.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: We must realize that all of God’s children wear the same jersey. Our team is the brotherhood of man. This mortal life is our playing field. Our goal is to learn to love God and to extend that same love toward our fellow man.

quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.quote: The greatest power God has given to His sons cannot be exercised without the companionship of one of His daughters.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: The same priesthood power that created worlds, galaxies, and the universe can and should be part of our lives to succor, strengthen, and bless our families, our friends, and our neighbors

quotes.author: L. Whitney Clayton
quotes.quote: Daily repentance is a transformative tool that enables us to grow a little kinder, more loving and more understanding.

quotes.author: Lynn G. Robbins
quotes.quote: No one is more on our side than the Savior. He allows us to take and keep retaking His exams.

quotes.author: D. Todd Christofferson
quotes.quote: Whatever the cost of repentance, it is swallowed up in the joy of forgiveness.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: Experience the strengthening power of daily repentance, of doing and being a little better each day.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: Let people repent. Let people grow. Believe that people can change and improve.

quotes.author: Dale G. Renlund
quotes.quote: The Savior's compassion in the face of our imperfections draw us toward Him and motivates us in our repeated struggles to repent.

quotes.author: Dale G. Renlund
quotes.quote: A saint is a sinner who keeps on trying.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: We need to bear in mind that people can change. They can put behind them bad habits. They can repent from transgressions. They can bear the priesthood worthily. And they can serve the Lord diligently… We can help them to overcome their shortcomings. We must develop the capacity to see men not as they are at present but as they may become when they receive testimonies of the gospel of Christ.

quotes.author: D. Todd Christofferson
quotes.quote:
Divine chastening has at least three purposes: (1) to persuade us to repent, (2) to refine and sanctify us, and (3) at times to redirect our course in life to what God knows is a better path.
Though it is often difficult to endure, truly we ought to rejoice that God considers us worth the time and trouble to correct.

quotes.author: Brad Wilcox
quotes.quote: Perhaps we feel we have stepped beyond that reach of the Atonement by knowingly repeating a previously forsaken sin. We understand that God and Jesus were willing to forgive the first time, but we wonder how many more times they will be willing to watch us bumble along before finally roll their eyes and declare, 'Enough already!' We struggle so much to forgive ourselves that we wrongly assume God must be having the same struggle.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: It is hard to know when we have done enough for the Atonement to change our natures and so qualify us for eternal life. And we don't know how many days we will have to give the service necessary for that mighty change to come. But we know that we will have days enough if only we don't waste them.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: Our only hope for true perfection is in receiving it as a gift from heaven--we can't “earn” it. Thus, the grace of Christ offers us not only salvation from sorrow and sin and death but also salvation from our own persistent self-criticism.

quotes.author: Dale G. Renlund
quotes.quote: A repenting sinner draws closer to God than does the self-righteous person who condemns that sinner.

quotes.author: Boyd K. Packer
quotes.quote: Often the most difficult part of repentance is to forgive yourself. Discouragement is part of that test. Do not give up. That brilliant morning will come.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Our task is to become our best selves. One of God's greatest gifts to us is the joy of trying again, for no failure ever need be final.

quotes.author: Spencer W. Kimball
quotes.quote: Since all of us sin in greater or lesser degree, we are all in need of constant repentance, of continually raising our sights and our performance.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: You can start over again and change your course from a downward, twisting, disappointing path to a superhighway to peace and happiness.

quotes.author: Joseph B. Wirthlin
quotes.quote: Mistakes that seem to be small to you, if uncorrected, can have enormous consequences.

quotes.author: Howard W. Hunter
quotes.quote: To those who have transgressed or been offended, we say, come back. The path of repentance, though hard at times, lifts one ever upward and leads to a perfect forgiveness.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Yes, we will make mistakes. Yes, we will falter. But as we seek to increase our love for God and strive to love our neighbor, the light of the gospel will surround and uplift us.

quotes.author: Gerrit W. Gong
quotes.quote: With you, I rejoice in the ongoing restoration of the fulness of the Gospel of Jesus Christ.

quotes.author: Brad Wilcox
quotes.quote: The Bible is not religion; it is a history of those who had religion. The religion of those who live within the covers of the Bible centered in living oracles and the ordinances of salvation. Theirs was a religion of prophets and apostles.

quotes.author: Quentin L. Cook
quotes.quote: Personal revelation is available to all those who humbly seek guidance from the Lord. It is as important as prophetic revelation.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: The messages of the adversary tend to be loud, bold, and boastful, whereas our Heavenly Father communicates simply, quietly, and with such stunning plainness that we cannot misunderstand Him.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: Joseph Smith showed us that the prayer of faith is the key to revelation from God.

quotes.author: Joy D. Jones
quotes.quote: Heeding personal revelation leads to personal progression.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: Every person is different and has a different contribution to make. No one is destined to fail. As you seek revelation to see gifts God sees in those you lead in the priesthood—particularly the young—you will be blessed to lift their sights to the service they can perform.

quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.quote: In many of the uncertainties and challenges we encounter in our lives, God requires us to do our best, to act and not be acted upon, and to trust in Him. We may not see angels, hear heavenly voices, or receive overwhelming spiritual impressions. We frequently may press forward hoping and praying—but without absolute assurance—that we are acting in accordance with God’s will. But as we honor our covenants and keep the commandments, as we strive ever more consistently to do good and to become better, we can walk with the confidence that God will guide our steps. And we can speak with the assurance that God will inspire our utterances.

quotes.author: L. Lionel Kendrick
quotes.quote: Heavenly Father…desires to continue to communicate with us and to give us counsel and direction. He does this through personal revelation, which involves preparation, prayer, and promptings. Personal revelation is one of the greatest gifts and blessings we can receive.

quotes.author: Bruce R. McConkie
quotes.quote: Revelation is something that should be received by every individual. God is no respecter of persons…any individual who abides the law that entitles him to get revelation…can entertain angels just as well as Joseph Smith entertained them, and can be in tune in full measure with all of the things of the Spirit.

quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.quote: The spirit of revelation… is not restricted to the presiding authorities of the Church; rather, it belongs to and should be operative in the life of every man, woman, and child who reaches the age of accountability and enters into sacred covenants. Sincere desire and worthiness invite the spirit of revelation into our lives.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: Sometimes we unwisely try to face life by depending on our own experience and capacity. It is much wiser for us to seek through prayer and divine inspiration to know what to do. Our obedience assures that when required, we can qualify for divine power to accomplish an inspired objective.

quotes.author: Julie B. Beck
quotes.quote: The ability to qualify for, receive, and acton personal revelation is the single most important skill that can be acquired in this life.

quotes.author: Joseph B. Wirthlin
quotes.quote: The Lord counsels us to become skilled in using…spiritual windows so we can seek and receive personal revelation for ourselves and our families. When the storms of life leave us confused, the windows of revelation can guide us safely home to our Heavenly Father.

quotes.author: Bruce R. McConkie
quotes.quote: Religion comes from God by revelation and deals with spiritual things; and unless and until a man has received revelation, he has not received religion, and he is not on the path leading to salvation in our Father’s kingdom.

quotes.author: D. Todd Christofferson
quotes.quote: Sacrifice means we really will do some good in the world.

quotes.author: Jean B. Bingham
quotes.quote: Satan incites comparison as a tool to create feelings of being superior or inferior, hiding the eternal truth that men's and women's innate differences are God given and equally valued.

quotes.author: Ezra Taft Benson
quotes.quote: There are times when you simply have to righteously hang on and outlast the devil.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: Satan has a powerful tool to use against good people. It is distraction. He would have good people fill life with “good things” so there is no room for the essential ones.

quotes.author: Joseph Smith Jr
quotes.quote: The devil flatters us that we are very righteous, while we are feeding on the faults of others.. if you would have God have mercy on you, have mercy on one another.

quotes.author: Ezra Taft Benson
quotes.quote: The devil knows if the elders of Israel should ever wake up they could step forth and help preserve freedom. Therefore the devil has concentrated, and to a large extent successfully, on neutralizing much of the priesthood.

quotes.author: James E. Faust
quotes.quote: We all have an inner braking system that will stop us before we follow Satan too far down the wrong road. It is the still, small voice within us. But if we allow ourselves to succumb to Satan’s tempting, the braking system begins to leak brake fluid and our stopping mechanism becomes weak and ineffective.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: Satan has become a master at using the addictive power of pornography to limit individual capacity to be led by the Spirit. The onslaught of pornography in all of its vicious, corroding, destructive forms has caused great grief, suffering, heartache, and destroyed marriages. It is one of the most damning influences on earth. Whether it be through the printed page, movies, television, obscene lyrics, vulgarities on the telephone, or flickering personal computer screen, pornography is overpoweringly addictive and severely damaging

quotes.author: Sheri Dew
quotes.quote: There is one thing the Lord and Lucifer have in common: they both desire for us to become as they are.

quotes.author: L. Tom Perry
quotes.quote: Satan, in his carefully devised plan to destroy the family, seeks to diminish the role of fathers. Increased youth violence, youth crime, greater poverty and economic insecurity, and the failure of increasing numbers of children in our schools offer clear evidence of lack of a positive influence of fathers in the homes. A family needs a father to anchor it.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: The way back is not as hard as it seems to you now. Satan wants you to think that it is impossible. That is not true.

quotes.author: Tessa Meyer Santiago
quotes.quote: If Satan can get us to fixate on our bodies either in vanity or self loathing, then he has caused us to misunderstand completely the role our bodies play in salvation.

quotes.author: L. Whitney Clayton
quotes.quote: Residents in the finest homes make time to study the scriptures and the words of living prophets every day.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: As we read and ponders the scriptures, we will experience the sweet whisperings of the spirit to our souls.

quotes.author: Joseph Smith Jr
quotes.quote: He who reads it oftenest will like it best.

quotes.author: Robert D. Hales
quotes.quote: When we want to speak to God, we pray. When we want Him to speak to us, we read the scriptures.

quotes.author: Joseph Smith Jr
quotes.quote: Those who have read the [the scriptures], and who have drunk of the steram of knowledge which they convery, know how to appreciate them.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: Scriptures are like packets of light that illumniate our minds and give place to guidance and inspiration from on high. They can become the key to open the channel to communion with our Faither in Heaven and His Beloved Son, Jesus Christ.

quotes.author: Boyd K. Packer
quotes.quote: The scriptures hold the keys to spiritual protection.

quotes.author: Mervyn B. Arnold
quotes.quote: The scriptures do not change, but we do, and so the same scriptures can give us new insights every time we read them.

quotes.author: Robert D. Hales
quotes.quote: If you have not heard His voice speaking to you lately, return with new eyes and ears to the scriptures.

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: Scriptures can calm an aigtated soul, giving peace, hope, and a restoration of confidence in one's ability to overcome the challenges of life. They have potent power to heal emotional challenges when there is faith in the Savior. They can accelerate physical healing.

quotes.author: Mormon 5:23
quotes.quote: Know ye not that ye are in the hands of God?

quotes.author: D&C 27:15
quotes.quote: Lift up your hearts and rejoice.

quotes.author: 1Nephi 1:20
quotes.quote: The tender mercies of the Lord are over all those whom He hath chosen.

quotes.author: Alma 39:14
quotes.quote: Seek not after riches nor the vain things of this world; for behold, you cannot carry them with you.

quotes.author: Ether 12:6
quotes.quote: Dispute not because ye see not, for ye receive no witness until after the trial of your faith.

quotes.author: Alma 32:43
quotes.quote: Ye shall reap the rewards of your faith, and your diligence, and patience.

quotes.author: Helaman 5:12
quotes.quote: It is upon the rock of our redeemer, who is Christ, the son of God that ye must build your foundation.

quotes.author: D&C 82:10
quotes.quote: I, the Lord, am bound when ye do what I say; but when ye do not what I say, ye have no promise.

quotes.author: Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.quote: We are the people charged with ushering in the second coming of Jesus Christ, we are the gather God's children, those who will hear and embrace the truths, covenants and promises of the everlasting gospel.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: As part of our preparation for His coming, He will lift each of us so we may rise to spiritual challenges and opportunities unlike any seen in the history of this world.

quotes.author: Douglas D. Holmes
quotes.quote: The Lord continues to put in place through His prophets all that is needed to help us prepare to receive Him.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: What would be the cumulative effect of millions of small, compassionate acts performed daily by us because of our heartfelt Christian love for others? Over time this would have a transformative effect upon all of our Heavenly Father’s children through the extension of His love to them through us.

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.quote: Generally speaking, the most miserable people I know are those who are obsessed with themselves; the happiest people I know are those who lose themselves in the service of others...By and large, I have come to see that if we complain about life, it is because we are thinking only of ourselves.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: May we ever watch over one another, assisting in times of need. Let us not be critical and judgmental, but let us be tolerant, ever emulating the Savior’s example of loving-kindness. In that vein, may we willingly serve one another. May we pray for the inspiration to know of the needs of those around us, and then may we go forward and provide assistance.

quotes.author: Carole M. Stephens
quotes.quote: We're all at different places on the path. But we can work together to help each other ‘press forward with a steadfastness in Christ, having a perfect brightness of hope, and a love of God and of all men.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: I pray that we may be aware of the needs of those around us. … May we ever be ready to extend to them a helping hand and a loving heart.

quotes.author: D. Todd Christofferson
quotes.quote: As disciples of Jesus Christ, we ought to do all we can to redeem others from suffering and burdens. Even so, our greatest redemptive service will be to lead them to Christ.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: The Lord … will more than recompense all who join in giving help to those in need.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: May we show increased kindness toward one another, and may we ever be found doing the work of the Lord.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: There are lives to brighten. There are hearts to touch. There are souls to save.

quotes.author: Linda K. Burton
quotes.quote: First observe, then serve.

quotes.author: Bonnie L. Oscarson
quotes.quote: There is no age barrier when it comes to Christlike service.

quotes.author: Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.quote: What He asks of each one of us is to be able and willing to take up the joyful ‘burden’ of discipleship.

quotes.author: M. Russell Ballard
quotes.quote: If we are truly disciples of the Lord Jesus Christ, we will reach out with love and understanding to all of our neighbors at all times.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: To find real happiness, we must seek for it in a focus outside ourselves.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: We are the Lord’s hands here upon the earth.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: What have I done for someone today?

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Unless we lose ourselves in service to others, there is little purpose to our own lives.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Often, the answer to our prayer does not come while we're on our knees but while we're on our feet serving the Lord and serving those around us

quotes.author: Marion G. Romney
quotes.quote: The sure way to peace and happiness in this life and life hereafter is to serve the Lord today and every day.

quotes.author: Brigham Young
quotes.quote: To accomplish this work there will have to be not only one temple but thousands of them, and thousands and tens of thousands of men and women will go into those temples and officiate for people who have lived as far back as the Lord shall reveal.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: The Lord has implored us to stand in holy places and be not moved.

quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.quote: Everything that is learned and all that is done in the temple emphasizes the divinity of Jesus Christ and His role in Heavenly Father's great plan of happiness.

quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.quote: We do not come to the temple to hide from or escape the evils of the world. Rather, we come to the temple to conquer the world of evil.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: The Lord wants all His children to partake of the eternal blessings available in the temple.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: All requirements to enter the temple relate to personal holiness.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: In some respects, it is easier to build a temple than it is to build a people prepared for a temple.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: Each holy temple stands as a symbol of our membership in the Church, as a sign of our faith in life after death, and as a sacred step toward eternal glory for us and our families.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: My brothers and sisters, temples are more than stone and mortar. They are filled with faith and fasting. They are built of trials and testimonies. They are sanctified by sacrifice and service.

quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.quote: Sometimes our needed growth is achieved better by suffering and adversity than by comfort and tranquility.

quotes.author: John A. McCune
quotes.quote: We understand clearly that not every trial we face will have a result we wish for

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Remember that the Lord will shape the back to bear the burden placed upon it.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Difficulties allow us to change for the better.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: The purpose of mortality is to learn and to grow to be more like our Father, and it is often during the difficult times that we learn the most, as painful as the lessons may be.

quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.quote: When faced with a trial of faith—whatever you do, you don't step away from the Church! Distancing yourself from the kingdom of God during a trial of faith is like leaving the safety of a secure storm cellar just as the tornado comes into view.

quotes.author: Boyd K. Packer
quotes.quote: It was meant to be that life would be a challenge. To suffer some anxiety, some depression, even some failure is normal. If you have a good, miserable day once in a while- or several in a row- stand steady and face them. Things will straighten out. There is great purpose in our struggle in life.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: If for a while, the harder you try, the harder it gets, take heart.

quotes.author: John H. Groberg
quotes.quote: Sometimes the Lord calms the storm, and sometimes he lets the storm rage and calms the child.

quotes.author: D. Todd Christofferson
quotes.quote: Obedience gives us greater control over our lives, greater capacity to come and go, to work and create. Of course, age, accident, and illnesses inevitably take their toll, but even so, our obedience to this gospel law enhances our capacity to deal with these challenges.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: When life is hard, remember - we are not the first to ask, 'Is there no other way?

quotes.author: David E. Sorenson
quotes.quote: Sometimes we find that even when we do our best to serve God, we still suffer. The key is to remember that faith and obedience are still the answers - even when things go wrong, perhaps especially when things go wrong

quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.quote: A pebble held close to the eye appears to be a gigantic obstacle. Cast on the ground, it is seen in perspective. Likewise, problems or trials in our lives need to be viewed in the perspective of scriptural doctrine. Otherwise they can easily overtake our vision, absorb our energy, and deprive us of the joy and beauty the Lord intends us to receive here on earth.

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.quote: Be believing, be happy, don't get discouraged. Things will work out.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Please be strong, and be alert to anything that would rob you of the blessing of eternity.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: Keep trying. Keep trusting. Keep believing. Keep growing. Heaven is cheering you on today, tomorrow and forever.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Even when you fail, you can choose not to give up, but rather discover your courage, press forward and rise up.

quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.quote: We are not and never need be alone. We can press forward in our daily lives with heavenly help.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: Face trouble with courage, disappointment with cheerfulness, and triumph with humility.

quotes.author: Quentin L. Cook
quotes.quote: Temporary setbacks are overshadowed by persistence.

quotes.author: Henry B. Eyring
quotes.quote: If you feel a little overwhelmed, take that as a good sign. It indicates that you can sense the magnitude of the trust God has placed in you.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: We are infinitely more than our limitations or our afflictions!

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: There will always be more blessings than burdens—even if some days it doesn't seem so.

quotes.author: Marvin J. Ashton
quotes.quote: God gives us difficulties to bring out the best in us.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: With God on our side we cannot fail.

quotes.author: Orson F. Whitney
quotes.quote: No pain that we suffer, no trial that we experience is wasted.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.quote: We will be tried to the fullest but this will lead us to be better. The stronger the wind, the stronger the tree.

quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.quote: No trial is so large we can’t overcome it together.

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.quote: If life gets too hard to stand, kneel.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: There will be times when you think you cannot continue on. Trust the Savior and His love.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: We all search for happiness, and we all try to find our own ‘happily ever after.’ … All you have to do is trust your Heavenly Father. Trust Him enough to follow His plan.

quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.quote: Challenges will come to you but as you trust in God, they will strengthen your faith.

quotes.author: W. Mark Bassett
quotes.quote: Faith and trust in the Lord requires us to acknowledge that His wisdom is superior to our own.

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.quote: It isn't as bad as you sometimes think it is. It all works out. Dont worry. If you do your best, it will all work out. Put your trust in God and move forward with faith.

quotes.author: Stanley G. Ellis
quotes.quote: God trust us. Do we trust him?

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: He created us to have joy! So if we trust Him, He will help us notice the good, bright, hopeful things of life. And sure enough, the world will become brighter.

quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.quote: Trust in God; Hold on to his love, know that one day the dawn will break brightly and all the shadows of mortality will flee.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: Faith is trust; trust that God sees what we cannot and that He knows what we do not.

quotes.author: Ronald A. Rasband
quotes.quote: Trusting in God's will is central to our mortality.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: We seek for truth wherever we might find it.

quotes.author: Lawerence E. Corbridge
quotes.quote: Truth will always be opposed

quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.quote: Tolerance for behavior is like a two-sided coin. Tolerance or respect is on one side of the coin, but truth is always on the other.

quotes.author: Cheryl A. Esplin
quotes.quote: When we receive light and truth, it is our responsibility to live it, to share it, and to defend it.

quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.quote: Absolute truth exists in a world that increasingly disdains and dismisses absolutes.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: The thing about truth is that it exist beyond belief. It is true even if nobody believes it.

quotes.author: Ezra Taft Benson
quotes.quote: Man must take time to meditate, to sweep the cobwebs from his mind, so that he might get a more firm grip on the truth.

quotes.author: Christel Uchtdorf Ash
quotes.quote: The truth will not always be popular but it will always be right.

quotes.author: Alan C. Batt
quotes.quote: As we seek answers, we must know that we will never find light and truth in the dark corners of the internet. When seeking truth, we must seek it where there is light, where we can feel the spirit.

quotes.author: Joseph Smith Jr
quotes.quote: The Standard of Truth has been erected; no unhallowed hand can stop the work from progressing; persecutions may rage, mobs may combine, armies may assemble, calumny may defame, but the truth of God will go forth boldly, nobly, and independent, till it has penetrated every continent, visited every clime, swept every country, and sounded in every ear, till the purposes of God shall be accomplished, and the Great Jehovah shall say the work is done.

quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.quote: We are surrounded by an astonishing wealth of light and truth.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: The truth of the Book of Mormon have the power to heal, comfort, restore, succor, strengthen, console and cheer our souls.

quotes.author: Boyd K. Packer
quotes.quote: We are meant to age, for with it comes the knowledge of the truth.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: Even when everyone is doing it, wrong is never right.

quotes.author: Neill F. Marriott
quotes.quote: Live truth fearlessly.

quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.quote: Stand up and speak for truth especially when it's not popular.

quotes.author: Jean B. Bingham
quotes.quote: When women and men work together, we accomplish a great deal more than we do working separately. Our roles are complementary rather than competitive.

quotes.author: Jean B. Bingham
